1	# PROGRAM.md — the live research program
2	
3	This is the single state document of the continuous research loop.
4	Every cycle reads it first and updates it last. Keep it honest, keep
5	it current, keep it short — history goes to `archive/`, results go to
6	`experiments/` and `novel/`.
7	
8	## Goal
9	
10	An O(polylog) algorithm computing the n-th prime p(n) (equivalently
11	π(x)) exactly. Target: p(10^100) in < 1 s, 100% accurate.
12	
13	**Honest position:** every known computation route is blocked — 730+
14	approaches catalogued in `status/CLOSED_PATHS.md`, four obstruction
15	theorems, the information-theoretic barrier (~√x zeta-zero phases,
16	GUE-random, behind the last ~50% of digits). The goal may require
17	mathematics that does not exist. The deliverable of each cycle is
18	honest progress: working algorithms/protocols, new structural facts
19	with measurements, precisely-closed questions with mechanisms,
20	adjacent-problem wins. Never a faked breakthrough.
21	
22	## ACTIVE LINE — the verification program (started S491, 2026-06-13)

24	Computation of π(x) is blocked at √x; *verification* is not. Built and
25	measured (all unconditionally sound, all with cheating-prover tests):

28	|---|---|---|---|

# PROGRAM.md — the live research program

This is the single state document of the continuous research loop.
Every cycle reads it first and updates it last. Keep it honest, keep
it current, keep it short — history goes to `archive/`, results go to
`experiments/` and `novel/`.

## Goal

An O(polylog) algorithm computing the n-th prime p(n) (equivalently
π(x)) exactly. Target: p(10^100) in < 1 s, 100% accurate.

**Honest position:** every known computation route is blocked — 730+
approaches catalogued in `status/CLOSED_PATHS.md`, four obstruction
theorems, the information-theoretic barrier (~√x zeta-zero phases,
GUE-random, behind the last ~50% of digits). The goal may require
mathematics that does not exist. The deliverable of each cycle is
honest progress: working algorithms/protocols, new structural facts
with measurements, precisely-closed questions with mechanisms,
adjacent-problem wins. Never a faked breakthrough.

## ACTIVE LINE — the verification program (started S491, 2026-06-13)

Computation of π(x) is blocked at √x; *verification* is not. Built and
measured (all unconditionally sound, all with cheating-prover tests):

| protocol | verifies | verifier | status |
|---|---|---|---|
| wheel sum-check | Φ(x, polylog wheel) | polylog | done |
| Lucy base | exact π(x) | Õ(x/log x) | done — π(2²⁰−1) verified |
| Lucy + delegated wiring | exact π(x) | **Õ(√x)** | done — crossover p≈130 measured |
| compressed-prover mult-trace (step 1) | batched `Σ_d eq(ρ,d)S̃(⌊X/(dp)⌋)` | polylog `O(m·Lv)` | done — trace-certified quotient, 6 cheat classes rejected |
| compressed Lucy layer (step 2) | one large-side layer over the √x state | polylog + O(nb·p) wiring | done — affine/trace dispatch, 5 cheat classes, outputs = true MLEs |
| compressed two-sided chain (step 3) | **exact π(x) over the √x state, all K layers** | Õ(√x) (waff O(nb·p) undelegated) | done — π(x)=sieve at n≤16; 9+3 cheat classes incl. self-consistent liar |
| compressed chain + delegated wiring (step 4) | same, **both wirings delegated** | **cleanly Õ(√x)**, O(nb·log p)/layer, no p-linear term | done — π(x)=sieve at n≤16; 13 cheat classes incl. 4 delegation-specific liars |
| structured chain prover (step 5) | same, **prover Õ(x)** not Õ(x^{3/2}) | unchanged Õ(√x) | done — bit-identical transcript; prover/chain-layer O(p²)→O(p), ratio→44× @p=1021 |
| structured prover IN the compressed chain (step 6) | same, on the REAL compressed √x-state chain | unchanged Õ(√x) | done — `--structured` threaded through `compressed_layer.py`; bit-identical (selftest 15); `--prover-bench` ratio→46× @p=1021, both wirings |

Canonical doc: `novel/succinct_verification_of_pi.md` (protocol stack,

115	            for v in range(p2, V + 1):
116	                ns[v] = small[v] - (small[v // p] - sp)
117	            for e in range(V):
118	                val = x // (e + 1)
119	                if val >= p2:
120	                    ep = (e + 1) * p
121	                    sval = large[ep - 1] if ep <= V else small[val // p]
122	                    nl[e] = large[e] - (sval - sp)
123	            small, large = ns, nl
124	            small_layers.append(small[:])
125	            large_layers.append(large[:])
126	    return primes, small_layers, large_layers

129	def corrupt_compressed(primes, sm_layers, lg_layers, x, i0):
130	    """Self-consistent liar: corrupt large_layers[i0][0] (the pi-carrying
131	    slot, = S_{i0}(x)) and re-propagate layers i0+1..K so the corrupted tables
132	    are mutually consistent. The small side is unchanged (its recurrence never
133	    reads the large side), so the corruption is large-only and must be caught
134	    at layer i0 where it meets the honest layer i0-1 below."""
135	    V = isqrt(x)
136	    K = len(primes)
137	    sm = [s[:] for s in sm_layers]
138	    lg = [l[:] for l in lg_layers]
139	    lg[i0][0] = lg[i0][0] + 1
140	    small, large = sm[i0][:], lg[i0][:]
141	    for j in range(i0 + 1, K + 1):
142	        p = primes[j - 1]
143	        sp, p2 = small[p - 1], p * p
144	        ns, nl = small[:], large[:]
145	        for v in range(p2, V + 1):
146	            ns[v] = small[v] - (small[v // p] - sp)
147	        for e in range(V):
148	            val = x // (e + 1)
149	            if val >= p2:
150	                ep = (e + 1) * p
151	                sval = large[ep - 1] if ep <= V else small[val // p]
152	                nl[e] = large[e] - (sval - sp)
153	        small, large = ns, nl
154	        sm[j], lg[j] = small[:], large[:]
155	    return sm, lg

162	def le_eval(r, M, n):
163	    """MLE of [e <= M] on n-bit e at point r. O(n)."""
164	    if M < 0:
165	        return 0
166	    if M >= (1 << n) - 1:
167	        return 1
168	    return (Q + 1 - ge_const_eval(r, M + 1, n)) % Q

171	def band_eval(r, lo, hi, n):
172	    """MLE of [lo <= e <= hi].  [lo<=e<=hi] = [e<=hi] - [e<=lo-1] pointwise,
173	    and the MLE is linear over that pointwise difference. O(n).  An EMPTY band
174	    (lo > hi, e.g. the small-side gate when p^2 > V) is the all-zero indicator,
175	    whose MLE is 0 -- and le(hi)-le(lo-1) is NOT 0 there, so guard it."""
176	    if lo > hi:
177	        return 0
178	    return (le_eval(r, hi, n) - le_eval(r, lo - 1, n)) % Q

181	def waff_eval(r_v, r_u, p, ecut, n):
182	    """MLE of the affine-region wiring W_aff(e, e') = [e <= ecut] * [e' = p*e
183	    + (p-1)] at (r_v over e, r_u over e').  e' = p*e+(p-1) <=> floor(e'/p)=e
184	    AND e' mod p = p-1, so a long-division automaton on e' (state = running
185	    remainder in [0,p)) whose emitted quotient bits must equal e, accepting
186	    on final remainder p-1, crossed with a 3-state comparator e<=ecut.
187	    Bits MSB-first. VERIFIER: O(n*p)."""
188	    st = {(0, 0): 1}                       # (remainder, cmp) -> weight; cmp 0=eq 1=gt 2=lt
189	    for j in range(n):
190	        cbit = (ecut >> (n - 1 - j)) & 1
191	        wv = [(Q + 1 - int(r_v[j])) % Q, int(r_v[j]) % Q]   # e bit
192	        wu = [(Q + 1 - int(r_u[j])) % Q, int(r_u[j]) % Q]   # e' bit
193	        new = {}
194	        for (rem, cmp), w in st.items():
195	            if w == 0:
196	                continue
197	            for epb in (0, 1):
198	                t = 2 * rem + epb
199	                qb, rem2 = divmod(t, p)
200	                if qb > 1:                 # quotient bit out of range -> dead
201	                    continue
202	                cmp2 = (cmp if cmp != 0 else
203	                        (1 if qb > cbit else 2 if qb < cbit else 0))
204	                wgt = w * wu[epb] % Q * wv[qb] % Q          # eb := qb (forced)
205	                key = (rem2, cmp2)
206	                new[key] = (new.get(key, 0) + wgt) % Q
207	        st = new
208	    return sum(w for (rem, cmp), w in st.items()
209	               if rem == p - 1 and cmp in (0, 2)) % Q       # e <= ecut

212	def verify_waff_value(waffv, r_v, r_u, p, ecut, nb, rng, stats,
213	                      lie_chain=False, structured=False):
214	    """Prove the affine-wiring scalar
215	        waffv = waff_eval(r_v, r_u) = sum_{e<=ecut} eq(r_v,e) eq(r_u,(e+1)p-1)
216	    with an O(nb log p) verifier that NEVER divides -- the delegated drop-in
217	    for the O(nb*p) waff_eval automaton.  Decomposition:
218	      waffv = sum_e EQ(r_v,e) * C(e) * Phi(e),  C(e)=[e<=ecut],
219	              Phi(e) = eq(r_u, (e+1)p-1) = the pure affine-image relation.
220	    An inner sum-check over the e-cube folds the comparator C (its MLE is the
221	    O(nb) le_eval -- the 3-state comparator KEPT AS-IS) and the eq(r_v,.),
222	    leaving a single claim Phi~(r_e) = D~(r_e, r_u) for the affine-image
223	    relation D(e,e')=[e'=p*e+(p-1)].  That claim is delegated to the SAME
224	    carry-chain template (lucy_dp_delegated_wiring.inner_verify_div) with the
225	    dividend = e' (point r_u), the quotient = e (point r_e), and acceptance
226	    restricted to final remainder == p-1.  Returns ok.
227	
228	    structured (S496 drop-in): when True the delegated inner_verify_div runs
229	    its backward chain sweep in O(nb*p) prover work (chain_layer_reduce_
230	    structured) instead of the dense O(nb*p^2) product-of-5-tables sweep, with
231	    a BIT-IDENTICAL transcript -- accept/reject and comm are unchanged.  Only
232	    affects the delegated path; the comparator fold above is already O(2^nb)."""
233	    Dml = 1 << nb
234	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
235	    eqrv = eq_table(r_v)
236	    eqru = eq_table(r_u)
237	    arange = np.arange(Dml, dtype=np.int64)
238	    img = (arange + 1) * p - 1                  # image of each e under the map
239	    vmask = img < Dml
240	    Phi = np.zeros(Dml, dtype=np.uint64)        # Phi[e] = eq(r_u, (e+1)p-1)
241	    Phi[arange[vmask]] = eqru[img[vmask]]
242	    Cind = (arange <= ecut).astype(np.uint64)   # [e <= ecut]
243	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
244	
245	    # inner sum-check (deg 3): waffv = sum_e EQrv(e) Cind(e) Phi(e)
246	    okI, r_e, finalI, scalI = sumcheck(waffv,
247	                                       {"EQ": eqrv.copy(), "C": Cind.copy(),
248	                                        "PHI": Phi.copy()},
249	                                       [(1, ["EQ", "C", "PHI"])], 3, rng)
250	    stats["comm"] += 4 * nb
251	    if not okI:
252	        return False
253	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
254	    phi_claim = scalI["PHI"]
255	    ok = (finalI % Q) == (eq_point(r_v, r_e) * le_eval(r_e, ecut, nb) % Q
256	                          * phi_claim) % Q
257	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
258	    if not ok:
259	        return False
260	    # delegate phi_claim = D~(r_e over quotient e, r_u over dividend e'),
261	    # D(e',e)=[e=floor(e'/p) and e' mod p = p-1]  <=>  e'=p*e+(p-1).
262	    return inner_verify_div(phi_claim, r_u, r_e, p, nb, rng, stats,
263	                            accept_rem=p - 1, lie=lie_chain,
264	                            structured=structured)

271	def verify_affine_region(S_large, r_v, claimed, p, ecut, nb, rng, stats,
272	                         cheat=None, delegate=False, structured=False):
273	    """g1_aff = sum_{e<=ecut} eq(r_v,e) S_large((e+1)p-1).  Routed by image
274	    index e': g1_aff = sum_{e'} Waff[e'] S_large(e').  The wiring scalar
275	    Waff~(r_u) = waff_eval(r_v, r_u) is either evaluated by the O(nb*p)
276	    automaton (delegate=False) or PROVEN by the O(nb*log p) inner protocol
277	    verify_waff_value (delegate=True).  cheat in
278	    {None,'waff','waff_forge','waff_chain'}.  structured passes the S496
279	    O(nb*p) chain prover down to verify_waff_value (delegate path only).
280	    Returns (ok, r_u, s2)."""
281	    Dml = 1 << nb
282	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
283	    eqrv = eq_table(r_v)
284	    Waff = np.zeros(Dml, dtype=np.uint64)
285	    for e in range(ecut + 1):
286	        ep1 = (e + 1) * p - 1
287	        if ep1 < Dml:
288	            Waff[ep1] = (int(Waff[ep1]) + int(eqrv[e])) % Q
289	    if cheat in ("waff", "waff_forge"):                     # wrong affine image
290	        bad = (p) % Dml
291	        Waff[bad] = (int(Waff[bad]) + 1) % Q
292	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
293	    okB, r_u, finalB, scal = sumcheck(claimed,
294	                                      {"W": Waff.copy(), "S": S_large.copy()},
295	                                      [(1, ["W", "S"])], 2, rng)
296	    stats["comm"] += 3 * nb
297	    if not okB:
298	        return False, None, None
299	    s2 = scal["S"]
300	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
301	    ok_open = s2 == mle_eval(S_large, r_u)
302	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
303	    if not ok_open:
304	        return False, None, None
305	
306	    if not delegate:
307	        t0 = time.perf_counter()
308	        waffv = waff_eval(r_v, r_u, p, ecut, nb)            # O(nb*p) automaton
309	        ok = (finalB % Q) == waffv * s2 % Q
310	        stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
311	        return (ok, r_u, s2) if ok else (False, None, None)
312	
313	    # delegate: prover supplies waffv (computed Õ(sqrt x), NO automaton), the
314	    # verifier binds it to finalB and PROVES it via verify_waff_value.
315	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
316	    if cheat == "waff_forge" and int(s2) % Q != 0:
317	        waffv = finalB % Q * pow(int(s2) % Q, Q - 2, Q) % Q  # forge to pass algebra
318	    else:
319	        eqru = eq_table(r_u)
320	        e_idx = np.arange(ecut + 1, dtype=np.int64)
321	        img = (e_idx + 1) * p - 1
322	        m = img < Dml
323	        waffv = int((eqrv[e_idx[m]].astype(np.uint64)
324	                     * eqru[img[m]] % Q).sum(dtype=np.uint64) % Q)
325	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
326	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
327	    ok = (finalB % Q) == waffv * s2 % Q
328	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
329	    if not ok:
330	        return False, None, None
331	    okw = verify_waff_value(waffv, r_v, r_u, p, ecut, nb, rng, stats,
332	                            lie_chain=(cheat == "waff_chain"),
333	                            structured=structured)

337	def verify_trace_region(W, S_small, r_v, claimed, lo, hi, nb, rng, stats):
338	    """g1_trace = sum_{lo<=e<=hi} eq(r_v,e) S_small(floor(x/((e+1)p))).
339	    Certify every u_e by the step-1 trace zero-test, then route the masked
340	    small-side lookup. The band mask T(e)=[lo<=e<=hi] zeroes the affine /
341	    padding columns (whose u_e exceed V) out of the routing.  The lookup is
342	    over nb-bit values (<= V), taking the LOW nb bits of the certified u_e,
343	    so omega / S_small stay sqrt x.  Returns (ok, r_B, s_B)."""
344	    if not verify_constraints(W, rng, stats):
345	        return False, None, None
346	    D, Lv = W["D"], W["Lv"]
347	    e = np.arange(D, dtype=np.int64)
348	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
349	    Tband = ((e >= lo) & (e <= hi)).astype(np.uint64)
350	    eqr = eq_table(r_v)
351	    weight = (eqr * Tband) % Q
352	    mask = (1 << nb) - 1
353	    vlow = (W["u"] & mask).astype(np.int64)                 # low nb bits of u_e
354	    omega = np.zeros(1 << nb, dtype=np.uint64)
355	    np.add.at(omega, vlow, weight)                          # < D summands < Q
356	    omega %= Q
357	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
358	
359	    # B1 (deg 2, v-cube): claimed = sum_v S_small(v) omega(v)
360	    okB1, r_B, finalB1, sB1 = sumcheck(claimed,
361	                                       {"S": S_small.copy(), "W": omega.copy()},
362	                                       [(1, ["S", "W"])], 2, rng)
363	    stats["comm"] += 3 * nb
364	    if not okB1:
365	        return False, None, None
366	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
367	    okf = ((finalB1 % Q) == sB1["S"] * sB1["W"] % Q
368	           and sB1["S"] == mle_eval(S_small, r_B))          # opening of S_small
369	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
370	    if not okf:
371	        return False, None, None
372	
373	    # B2 (deg nb+2, e-cube): sB1[W] = sum_e eq(r_v,e) T(e) prod_k EB_k(e),
374	    #   EB_k = eq(r_B[k], Ub_{Lv-nb+k})  (the LOW nb bits of the SAME u_e).
375	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
376	    tabs = {"EQ": eq_table(r_v), "T": Tband.copy()}
377	    ebn, jidx = [], []
378	    for k in range(nb):
379	        j = Lv - nb + k
380	        jidx.append(j)
381	        rb = int(r_B[k]) % Q
382	        Ub = W["tabs"][f"Ub{j}"].astype(np.uint64)
383	        tabs[f"EB{k}"] = (((1 - rb) % Q) + ((2 * rb - 1) % Q) * Ub) % Q
384	        ebn.append(f"EB{k}")
385	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
386	    okB2, r_C, finalB2, _ = sumcheck(sB1["W"], tabs,
387	                                     [(1, ["EQ", "T"] + ebn)], nb + 2, rng)
388	    stats["comm"] += (nb + 3) * nb
389	    if not okB2:
390	        return False, None, None
391	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
392	    expect = eq_point(r_v, r_C) * band_eval(r_C, lo, hi, nb) % Q
393	    for k in range(nb):
394	        rb = int(r_B[k]) % Q
395	        ub = mle_eval(W["tabs"][f"Ub{jidx[k]}"], r_C)       # opening of Ub_j
396	        expect = expect * (((1 - rb) % Q) + ((2 * rb - 1) % Q) * ub) % Q
397	    ok = (finalB2 % Q) == expect
398	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
399	    return ok, r_B, sB1["S"]

406	def line_batch_pair(S, pt0, val0, pt1, val1, nb, rng, stats):
407	    """Reduce val0=S~(pt0), val1=S~(pt1) to ONE claim (new_pt, new_claim) via
408	    the degree-nb line restriction h(t)=S~((1-t)pt0+t pt1). Endpoint checks
409	    anchor a false input; new_claim is closed by mle_eval (the PCS stand-in)."""
410	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
411	    hs = []
412	    for t in range(nb + 1):
413	        tf = t % Q
414	        gp = [((Q + 1 - tf) * int(a) + tf * int(b)) % Q
415	              for a, b in zip(pt0, pt1)]
416	        hs.append(mle_eval(S, gp))
417	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
418	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
419	    ok = hs[0] == val0 and hs[1] == val1
420	    tstar = int(rng.integers(0, Q))
421	    new_claim = lagrange_eval(hs, tstar)
422	    new_pt = [((Q + 1 - tstar) * int(a) + tstar * int(b)) % Q
423	              for a, b in zip(pt0, pt1)]
424	    ok = ok and new_claim == mle_eval(S, new_pt)            # leaf close
425	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
426	    stats["comm"] += nb + 1
427	    return new_pt, new_claim, ok

430	def batch_on_table(S, claims, nb, rng, stats):
431	    """Fold k same-table point-claims into one by sequential line restriction.
432	    claims: list of (point, value). Returns (point, value, ok)."""
433	    pt, val = claims[0]
434	    if len(claims) == 1:                                    # still anchor it
435	        t0 = time.perf_counter()
436	        ok = val == mle_eval(S, pt)
437	        stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
438	        return pt, val, ok
439	    ok = True
440	    for (pt1, val1) in claims[1:]:
441	        pt, val, okp = line_batch_pair(S, pt, val, pt1, val1, nb, rng, stats)
442	        ok = ok and okp
443	    return pt, val, ok

457	def large_reduce(x, p, sp, ecut, nb, S_prev_small, S_prev_large, z, C,
458	                 rng, stats, cheat=None, delegate=False, structured=False):
459	    """Reduce S~_i^large(z)=C to: a large point-claim (new_z,new_claim) on
460	    S_{i-1}^large (line-batched s1@r_v + s2_aff@r_u) and a small point-claim
461	    (r_B,s_B) on S_{i-1}^small (trace region). cheat in
462	    {None,'G','split','u','waff','waff_forge','waff_chain'};
463	    'wrong_C'/'delta_pi' handled by callers via C.  delegate routes the affine
464	    wiring scalar through the O(nb log p) inner protocol; structured makes that
465	    inner protocol's chain prover O(nb*p) (S496 drop-in, delegate path only)."""
466	    V = isqrt(x)
467	    ci = sp % Q
468	    lo, hi = ecut + 1, V - 1
469	    Bcut = min(V - 1, x // (p * p) - 1)
470	    Dml = 1 << nb
471	
472	    # prover-committed G table over the e-cube
473	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
474	    G = np.zeros(Dml, dtype=np.uint64)
475	    for e in range(V):
476	        ep = (e + 1) * p
477	        G[e] = S_prev_large[ep - 1] if ep <= V else S_prev_small[x // ep]
478	    if cheat == "G":
479	        G[0] = (int(G[0]) + 1) % Q
480	    Bf = (np.arange(Dml) <= Bcut).astype(np.uint64)
481	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
482	
483	    # ---- phase A ----
484	    termsA = [(1, ["EQ", "S"]), (Q - 1, ["EQ", "B", "G"]), (ci, ["EQ", "B"])]
485	    okA, r_v, finalA, scal = sumcheck(C, {"EQ": eq_table(z),
486	                                          "S": S_prev_large.copy(),
487	                                          "B": Bf.copy(), "G": G.copy()},
488	                                      termsA, 3, rng)
489	    stats["comm"] += 4 * nb
490	    if not okA:
491	        return dict(accepted=False)
492	    s1, g1 = scal["S"], scal["G"]
493	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
494	    bv = le_eval(r_v, Bcut, nb)
495	    expect = eq_point(z, r_v) * ((s1 - bv * ((g1 - ci) % Q)) % Q) % Q
496	    okA2 = (finalA % Q) == expect
497	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
498	    if not okA2:
499	        return dict(accepted=False)
500	
501	    # ---- honest split of g1 ----
502	    eqrv_full = eq_table(r_v)
503	    g1_aff = 0
504	    for e in range(ecut + 1):
505	        g1_aff = (g1_aff + int(eqrv_full[e]) * int(S_prev_large[(e + 1) * p - 1])) % Q
506	    g1_trace = 0
507	    for e in range(lo, hi + 1):
508	        g1_trace = (g1_trace + int(eqrv_full[e]) * int(S_prev_small[x // ((e + 1) * p)])) % Q
509	    if cheat == "split":
510	        g1_aff = (g1_aff + 1) % Q
511	        g1_trace = (g1_trace - 1) % Q
512	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
513	    ok_sum = (g1_aff + g1_trace) % Q == g1 % Q
514	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
515	    if not ok_sum:
516	        return dict(accepted=False)
517	
518	    # ---- affine region ----
519	    okAff, r_u, s2_aff = verify_affine_region(
520	        S_prev_large, r_v, g1_aff, p, ecut, nb, rng, stats,
521	        cheat=(cheat if cheat in ("waff", "waff_forge", "waff_chain")
522	               else None),
523	        delegate=delegate, structured=structured)
524	    if not okAff:
525	        return dict(accepted=False)
526	
527	    # ---- trace region ----
528	    W = build_witness(x, p, nb, dstart=1)
529	    if cheat == "u":                                        # wrong quotient in trace
530	        d = max(lo, 1) % W["D"]
531	        W["tabs"]["U"] = W["tabs"]["U"].copy()
532	        W["tabs"]["U"][d] = (int(W["tabs"]["U"][d]) + 1) % Q
533	    okTr, r_B, s_B = verify_trace_region(
534	        W, S_prev_small, r_v, g1_trace, lo, hi, nb, rng, stats)
535	    if not okTr:
536	        return dict(accepted=False)

548	def small_reduce(x, p, sp, nb, S_prev_small, z, C, rng, stats, cheat=None,
549	                 delegate=False, structured=False):
550	    """Reduce S~_i^small(z)=C to TWO point-claims on S_{i-1}^small:
551	    (r_v,s1) [the v itself] and (r_u,s2) [floor(v/p)]. The wiring v->floor(v/p)
552	    stays entirely small-side (value->value): the existing division automaton.
553	    Gate B(v)=[p^2<=v<=V] is a BAND (the upper bound keeps the recurrence off
554	    the padding). cheat in {None,'small_G','small_u','small_forge',
555	    'small_chain'}; 'small_C' via C.  delegate routes the division wiring
556	    scalar W~(r_v,r_u) through the SAME carry-chain (inner_verify_div);
557	    structured makes that chain prover O(nb*p) (S496 drop-in, delegate only)."""
558	    V = isqrt(x)
559	    ci = sp % Q
560	    p2 = p * p
561	    Dml = 1 << nb
562	    arange = np.arange(Dml, dtype=np.int64)
563	
564	    # ---- phase A: C = sum_v eq(z,v)[S(v) - B(v)(G(v)-ci)] ----
565	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
566	    Bf = ((arange >= p2) & (arange <= V)).astype(np.uint64)     # band [p^2<=v<=V]
567	    Gf = S_prev_small[arange // p].astype(np.uint64).copy()     # G(v)=S(floor(v/p))
568	    if cheat == "small_G":
569	        gi = (p2) % Dml
570	        Gf[gi] = (int(Gf[gi]) + 1) % Q
571	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
572	    termsA = [(1, ["EQ", "S"]), (Q - 1, ["EQ", "B", "G"]), (ci, ["EQ", "B"])]
573	    okA, r_v, finalA, scal = sumcheck(C, {"EQ": eq_table(z),
574	                                          "S": S_prev_small.copy(),
575	                                          "B": Bf.copy(), "G": Gf.copy()},
576	                                      termsA, 3, rng)
577	    stats["comm"] += 4 * nb
578	    if not okA:
579	        return dict(accepted=False)
580	    s1, g1 = scal["S"], scal["G"]
581	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
582	    bv = band_eval(r_v, p2, V, nb)
583	    expect = eq_point(z, r_v) * ((s1 - bv * ((g1 - ci) % Q)) % Q) % Q
584	    okA2 = (finalA % Q) == expect
585	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
586	    if not okA2:
587	        return dict(accepted=False)
588	
589	    # ---- phase B: g1 = sum_u W(r_v,u) S(u),  W(v,u)=[u=floor(v/p)] ----
590	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
591	    eqrv = eq_table(r_v)
592	    Wt = np.zeros(Dml, dtype=np.uint64)
593	    np.add.at(Wt, arange // p, eqrv)                        # < p summands < Q
594	    Wt %= Q
595	    if cheat in ("small_u", "small_forge"):
596	        Wt[0] = (int(Wt[0]) + 1) % Q
597	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
598	    okB, r_u, finalB, scalB = sumcheck(g1, {"W": Wt, "S": S_prev_small.copy()},
599	                                       [(1, ["W", "S"])], 2, rng)
600	    stats["comm"] += 3 * nb
601	    if not okB:
602	        return dict(accepted=False)
603	    s2 = scalB["S"]
604	
605	    if not delegate:
606	        t0 = time.perf_counter()
607	        wv = w_div_eval(r_v, r_u, p, nb)                    # O(nb*p) automaton
608	        okB2 = (finalB % Q) == wv * s2 % Q
609	        stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
610	        if not okB2:
611	            return dict(accepted=False)
612	        return dict(accepted=True, claims=[(r_v, s1), (r_u, s2)])
613	
614	    # delegate: prover supplies the wiring scalar (Õ(sqrt x), NO automaton),
615	    # verifier binds it to finalB then PROVES it via the carry chain.
616	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
617	    if cheat == "small_forge" and int(s2) % Q != 0:
618	        wv_claim = finalB % Q * pow(int(s2) % Q, Q - 2, Q) % Q  # forge to pass algebra
619	    else:
620	        eqru = eq_table(r_u)
621	        wv_claim = int((eqrv.astype(np.uint64)
622	                        * eqru[arange // p] % Q).sum(dtype=np.uint64) % Q)
623	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
624	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
625	    okB2 = (finalB % Q) == wv_claim * s2 % Q
626	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
627	    if not okB2:
628	        return dict(accepted=False)
629	    if not inner_verify_div(wv_claim, r_v, r_u, p, nb, rng, stats,
630	                            accept_rem=None, lie=(cheat == "small_chain"),
631	                            structured=structured):
632	        return dict(accepted=False)
633	    return dict(accepted=True, claims=[(r_v, s1), (r_u, s2)])

681	                        structured=False):
682	    """Verify ONE full two-sided layer: (large-claim, small-claim) ->
683	    (large-claim', small-claim'). Small-side claims about S_{i-1}^small (s_B
684	    from the large trace + the two from the small layer) are folded to one."""
685	    V = isqrt(x)
686	    nb = max(1, V.bit_length())
687	    primes, sm_layers, lg_layers = compressed_lucy(x)
688	    assert 1 <= layer <= len(primes)
689	    p = primes[layer - 1]
690	    sp = sm_layers[layer - 1][p - 1]
691	    ecut = V // p - 1
692	    S_prev_small = pad(sm_layers[layer - 1], nb)
693	    S_prev_large = pad(lg_layers[layer - 1], nb)
694	    S_i_large = pad(lg_layers[layer], nb)
695	    S_i_small = pad(sm_layers[layer], nb)
696	    stats = {"t_prover": 0.0, "t_verifier": 0.0, "comm": 0}
697	
698	    zL = [int(rng.integers(0, Q)) for _ in range(nb)]
699	    zS = [int(rng.integers(0, Q)) for _ in range(nb)]
700	    CL = mle_eval(S_i_large, zL)
701	    CS = mle_eval(S_i_small, zS)
702	    if cheat == "wrong_C":
703	        CL = (CL + 1) % Q
704	    if cheat == "small_C":
705	        CS = (CS + 1) % Q
706	
707	    lres = large_reduce(x, p, sp, ecut, nb, S_prev_small, S_prev_large, zL, CL,
708	                        rng, stats,
709	                        cheat=(cheat if cheat in ("G", "split", "u", "waff",

711	                               else None),

715	    sres = small_reduce(x, p, sp, nb, S_prev_small, zS, CS, rng, stats,

717	                                                  "small_forge", "small_chain")
718	                               else None),
719	                        delegate=delegate, structured=structured)
720	    if not sres["accepted"]:
721	        return dict(accepted=False, x=x, p=p, nb=nb, ecut=ecut, **stats)
722	
723	    sB = lres["s_B"]
724	    if cheat == "carry":                                    # tamper cross-side carry
725	        sB = (sB + 1) % Q
726	    small_claims = [(lres["r_B"], sB)] + sres["claims"]
727	    zS2, CS2, okb = batch_on_table(S_prev_small, small_claims, nb, rng, stats)
728	
729	    out_ok = (okb
730	              and CS2 == mle_eval(S_prev_small, zS2)
731	              and lres["new_claim"] == mle_eval(S_prev_large, lres["new_z"]))
732	    return dict(accepted=out_ok, x=x, p=p, nb=nb, ecut=ecut,
733	                CS2=CS2, zS2=zS2, new_claim=lres["new_claim"],
734	                new_z=lres["new_z"], S_prev_small=S_prev_small,
735	                S_prev_large=S_prev_large, **stats)

742	def run_chain(x, rng, cheat=None, corrupt_layer=None, delegate=False,
743	              structured=False):
744	    """Chain all K layers from S_K^large(e=0)=pi(x) down to S_0 (opened on
745	    both sides). cheat='delta_pi' lies about pi(x); corrupt_layer=i0 is a
746	    self-consistent liar. delegate routes BOTH wirings (small division,
747	    large affine image) through the O(nb log p) inner protocol -- the whole
748	    per-layer verifier is then O(nb log p), no p-linear automaton term.
749	    structured (delegate only) makes the inner chain PROVER O(nb*p) per wiring
750	    (S496 drop-in) -- whole-chain wiring prover Õ(x^{3/2})->Õ(x), transcript
751	    bit-identical.  Returns dict(accepted, claimed, layers, ...)."""
752	    V = isqrt(x)
753	    nb = max(1, V.bit_length())
754	    primes, sm_layers, lg_layers = compressed_lucy(x)
755	    K = len(primes)
756	    if corrupt_layer is not None:
757	        sm_layers, lg_layers = corrupt_compressed(primes, sm_layers,
758	                                                  lg_layers, x, corrupt_layer)
759	    claimed_pi = lg_layers[K][0]
760	    if cheat == "delta_pi":
761	        claimed_pi += 1
762	
763	    stats = {"t_prover": 0.0, "t_verifier": 0.0, "comm": 0}
764	    z_large = [0] * nb                                       # Boolean point e=0
765	    C_large = claimed_pi % Q
766	    z_small, C_small = None, None
767	
768	    def fail():
769	        return dict(accepted=False, claimed=claimed_pi, layers=K, **stats)
770	
771	    for i in range(K, 0, -1):
772	        p = primes[i - 1]
773	        sp = sm_layers[i - 1][p - 1]
774	        ecut = V // p - 1
775	        S_prev_small = pad(sm_layers[i - 1], nb)
776	        S_prev_large = pad(lg_layers[i - 1], nb)
777	
778	        lres = large_reduce(x, p, sp, ecut, nb, S_prev_small, S_prev_large,
779	                            z_large, C_large, rng, stats, delegate=delegate,
780	                            structured=structured)
781	        if not lres["accepted"]:
782	            return fail()
783	        small_claims = [(lres["r_B"], lres["s_B"])]
784	        if C_small is not None:                             # skipped at i=K
785	            sres = small_reduce(x, p, sp, nb, S_prev_small, z_small, C_small,
786	                                rng, stats, delegate=delegate,
787	                                structured=structured)
788	            if not sres["accepted"]:
789	                return fail()
790	            small_claims += sres["claims"]
791	        z_small, C_small, okb = batch_on_table(S_prev_small, small_claims,
792	                                               nb, rng, stats)
793	        if not okb:
794	            return fail()
795	        z_large, C_large = lres["new_z"], lres["new_claim"]
796	
797	    # base: open S_0 on both sides (leaf-opening stand-in, O(sqrt x) once)
798	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
799	    S0_large = pad(lg_layers[0], nb)
800	    S0_small = pad(sm_layers[0], nb)
801	    ok = (C_large == mle_eval(S0_large, z_large)
802	          and C_small == mle_eval(S0_small, z_small))
803	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
804	    return dict(accepted=ok, claimed=claimed_pi, layers=K, **stats)

811	def sieve_pi(x):
812	    s = np.ones(x + 1, dtype=bool)
813	    s[:2] = False
814	    for q in range(2, isqrt(x) + 1):

816	            s[q * q::q] = False
817	    return int(s.sum())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
compressed_layer.py — S493/S494, compressed-prover steps 2 & 3.

Step 1 (compressed_prover_mult_trace.py) built, in isolation, the batched
multiplication-trace sum-check that certifies a small-side value lookup
C = sum_d eq(rho,d) S~(floor(X/(d p))) with a polylog verifier that never
divides. Step 2 (S493) integrated it into ONE large-side Lucy layer over the
compressed O(sqrt x)-size state. Step 3 (S494, THIS file) adds the SMALL-side
layer and CHAINS all K layers into an end-to-end verification of pi(x) over
the compressed state -- the gate to a production Õ(sqrt x) prover (the demo
prover of lucy_dp_verification materializes the full 2^n table, Õ(x^{3/2})).

The compressed Lucy_Hedgehog key-value DP, V = floor(sqrt x), nb = bits(V):
  small[v]  = S(v)              value-addressed,  v in [1, V]   (index = value)
  large[e]  = S(floor(x/(e+1))) d-addressed,      e in [0, V-1] (index e = d-1)
and pi(x) = large[0] after sieving by every prime <= V. Both sides are padded
to the nb-cube of size 2^nb (V < 2^nb <= 2V); padding entries are 0 every
layer.

The layer recurrence S_i(w) = S_{i-1}(w) - [w>=p^2]*(S_{i-1}(floor(w/p))-(i-1)).

LARGE side (key w = floor(x/(e+1)), step 2): floor(w/p)=floor(x/((e+1)p)).
With ep=(e+1)p, ep<=V is an AFFINE large-index map e->ep-1 (long-division
automaton waff_eval, no trace); ep>V is a SMALL value looked up by value
WITHOUT the verifier dividing -- step 1's trace primitive. Phase-A folds
validity AND the p^2 gate into ONE threshold B(e)=[e<=Bcut]; phase-B splits
g1=g1_aff+g1_trace and dispatches per key. Outputs: a large point-claim
(line-batched s1@r_v + s2_aff@r_u) and a SMALL point-claim s_B@r_B (carried).

SMALL side (key w = v, step 3, NEW): floor(w/p)=floor(v/p) stays ENTIRELY
within the small side (value->value) -- the existing division automaton
w_div_eval / lucy_dp_verification.verify_layer phase-B over the nb-cube. The
gate is a BAND B(v)=[p^2<=v<=V]: the upper bound [v<=V] is load-bearing in
general (it keeps the recurrence off the padding columns whose update would
otherwise corrupt the zero padding); when V=2^nb-1 (x=2^n-1, n even) the band
collapses to the bare comparator [v>=p^2] of the NEXT-ACTION note -- so the
"comparator suffices, no validity fold" claim holds exactly in the no-padding
case and the band is its general-V refinement. The small layer emits TWO
point-claims on S_{i-1}^small: s1@r_v (the v itself) and s2@r_u (floor(v/p)).

CHAIN (step 3). Per layer we carry a width-2 claim vector
(large-claim about S_i^large, small-claim about S_i^small). Start: layer K
has only large-claim S_K^large(e=0)=pi(x) (no S_K^small is referenced).
Running layer i:
  * large_reduce consumes the large-claim -> a large-claim about S_{i-1}^large
    AND a small-claim s_B about S_{i-1}^small (its trace region);
  * small_reduce (skipped at i=K) consumes the small-claim -> two small-claims
    about S_{i-1}^small.
The same-table claims about S_{i-1}^small (s_B + the two from small_reduce)
are folded by sequential LINE restriction into one; the large-claim is its own
line-batch. Base: open S_0 on both sides. Soundness: a self-consistent liar
(corrupt one DP entry, re-propagate upward) is caught at the layer where the
corruption meets the honest layer below -- phase-A's round-1 sum on the honest
S_{i-1} tables disagrees with the corrupted carried claim.

Leaf openings of committed tables (incl. the two S_0 bases) are closed here by
direct MLE evaluation -- the stand-in for the polynomial-commitment / outer-
protocol line batching, identical to steps 1-2's scope. The S_0 bases have no
cheap closed form (floor(x/(e+1)) on the large side; padded max(v-1,0) on the
small side), so they are opened directly: a ONE-TIME O(sqrt x), within the
Õ(sqrt x) budget. The reduction logic is real: every per-layer check is a
genuine MLE-consistency test against true wiring (eq, band/threshold
comparators, division & affine automata); honest accepts, every cheating
prover is rejected.

Sizes (the point of the line): small & large cubes 2^nb ~ sqrt x; the trace
constraint test runs on the e-cube with Lv=O(log x) bit tables -> prover
Õ(sqrt x); verifier touches only nb-length points and O(nb)-state automata
(except waff's O(nb*p), delegatable to O(nb*log p)).

What would falsify this: the compressed DP disagreeing with a sieve; an honest
layer or honest chain rejected; output/base claims not equal to the true MLEs;
any cheating prover (corrupted DP claim/table, wrong region split, wrong trace
quotient, wrong affine image, corrupted small-side wiring, tampered cross-side
carry, wrong claimed pi) accepted above the field soundness bound; or verifier
work scaling with 2^n instead of nb.

Usage:
  python3 compressed_layer.py --selftest
  python3 compressed_layer.py --n 12 --cheat-trials 20
  python3 compressed_layer.py --bench
"""

import argparse
import time
from math import isqrt

import numpy as np

from lucy_dp_verification import (Q, lagrange_eval, eq_table, eq_point,
                                  mle_eval, ge_const_eval, w_div_eval, sumcheck)
from compressed_prover_mult_trace import build_witness, verify_constraints
from lucy_dp_delegated_wiring import inner_verify_div, inner_chain_vectors


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# the compressed Lucy_Hedgehog DP (prover substrate), all layers, exact
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

def compressed_lucy(x):
    """Return (primes, small_layers, large_layers).
    small_layers[i][v] = S_i(v) for v in [0,V];  small_layers[0] = S_0.
    large_layers[i][e] = S_i(floor(x/(e+1))) for e in [0,V).
    pi(x) = large_layers[-1][0]."""
    V = isqrt(x)
    small = [max(v - 1, 0) for v in range(V + 1)]
    large = [(x // (e + 1)) - 1 for e in range(V)]
    small_layers, large_layers, primes = [small[:]], [large[:]], []
    for p in range(2, V + 1):
        if small[p] - small[p - 1] > 0:                     # p is prime
            primes.append(p)
            sp, p2 = small[p - 1], p * p
            ns, nl = small[:], large[:]
            for v in range(p2, V + 1):
                ns[v] = small[v] - (small[v // p] - sp)
            for e in range(V):
                val = x // (e + 1)
                if val >= p2:
                    ep = (e + 1) * p
                    sval = large[ep - 1] if ep <= V else small[val // p]
                    nl[e] = large[e] - (sval - sp)
            small, large = ns, nl
            small_layers.append(small[:])
            large_layers.append(large[:])
    return primes, small_layers, large_layers


def corrupt_compressed(primes, sm_layers, lg_layers, x, i0):
    """Self-consistent liar: corrupt large_layers[i0][0] (the pi-carrying
    slot, = S_{i0}(x)) and re-propagate layers i0+1..K so the corrupted tables
    are mutually consistent. The small side is unchanged (its recurrence never
    reads the large side), so the corruption is large-only and must be caught
    at layer i0 where it meets the honest layer i0-1 below."""
    V = isqrt(x)
    K = len(primes)
    sm = [s[:] for s in sm_layers]
    lg = [l[:] for l in lg_layers]
    lg[i0][0] = lg[i0][0] + 1
    small, large = sm[i0][:], lg[i0][:]
    for j in range(i0 + 1, K + 1):
        p = primes[j - 1]
        sp, p2 = small[p - 1], p * p
        ns, nl = small[:], large[:]
        for v in range(p2, V + 1):
            ns[v] = small[v] - (small[v // p] - sp)
        for e in range(V):
            val = x // (e + 1)
            if val >= p2:
                ep = (e + 1) * p
                sval = large[ep - 1] if ep <= V else small[val // p]
                nl[e] = large[e] - (sval - sp)
        small, large = ns, nl
        sm[j], lg[j] = small[:], large[:]
    return sm, lg


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# verifier-side O(nb) threshold MLEs and the O(nb*p) affine-wiring MLE
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

def le_eval(r, M, n):
    """MLE of [e <= M] on n-bit e at point r. O(n)."""
    if M < 0:
        return 0
    if M >= (1 << n) - 1:
        return 1
    return (Q + 1 - ge_const_eval(r, M + 1, n)) % Q


def band_eval(r, lo, hi, n):
    """MLE of [lo <= e <= hi].  [lo<=e<=hi] = [e<=hi] - [e<=lo-1] pointwise,
    and the MLE is linear over that pointwise difference. O(n).  An EMPTY band
    (lo > hi, e.g. the small-side gate when p^2 > V) is the all-zero indicator,
    whose MLE is 0 -- and le(hi)-le(lo-1) is NOT 0 there, so guard it."""
    if lo > hi:
        return 0
    return (le_eval(r, hi, n) - le_eval(r, lo - 1, n)) % Q


def waff_eval(r_v, r_u, p, ecut, n):
    """MLE of the affine-region wiring W_aff(e, e') = [e <= ecut] * [e' = p*e
    + (p-1)] at (r_v over e, r_u over e').  e' = p*e+(p-1) <=> floor(e'/p)=e
    AND e' mod p = p-1, so a long-division automaton on e' (state = running
    remainder in [0,p)) whose emitted quotient bits must equal e, accepting
    on final remainder p-1, crossed with a 3-state comparator e<=ecut.
    Bits MSB-first. VERIFIER: O(n*p)."""
    st = {(0, 0): 1}                       # (remainder, cmp) -> weight; cmp 0=eq 1=gt 2=lt
    for j in range(n):
        cbit = (ecut >> (n - 1 - j)) & 1
        wv = [(Q + 1 - int(r_v[j])) % Q, int(r_v[j]) % Q]   # e bit
        wu = [(Q + 1 - int(r_u[j])) % Q, int(r_u[j]) % Q]   # e' bit
        new = {}
        for (rem, cmp), w in st.items():
            if w == 0:
                continue
            for epb in (0, 1):
                t = 2 * rem + epb
                qb, rem2 = divmod(t, p)
                if qb > 1:                 # quotient bit out of range -> dead
                    continue
                cmp2 = (cmp if cmp != 0 else
                        (1 if qb > cbit else 2 if qb < cbit else 0))
                wgt = w * wu[epb] % Q * wv[qb] % Q          # eb := qb (forced)
                key = (rem2, cmp2)
                new[key] = (new.get(key, 0) + wgt) % Q
        st = new
    return sum(w for (rem, cmp), w in st.items()
               if rem == p - 1 and cmp in (0, 2)) % Q       # e <= ecut


def verify_waff_value(waffv, r_v, r_u, p, ecut, nb, rng, stats,
                      lie_chain=False, structured=False):
    """Prove the affine-wiring scalar
        waffv = waff_eval(r_v, r_u) = sum_{e<=ecut} eq(r_v,e) eq(r_u,(e+1)p-1)
    with an O(nb log p) verifier that NEVER divides -- the delegated drop-in
    for the O(nb*p) waff_eval automaton.  Decomposition:
      waffv = sum_e EQ(r_v,e) * C(e) * Phi(e),  C(e)=[e<=ecut],
              Phi(e) = eq(r_u, (e+1)p-1) = the pure affine-image relation.
    An inner sum-check over the e-cube folds the comparator C (its MLE is the
    O(nb) le_eval -- the 3-state comparator KEPT AS-IS) and the eq(r_v,.),
    leaving a single claim Phi~(r_e) = D~(r_e, r_u) for the affine-image
    relation D(e,e')=[e'=p*e+(p-1)].  That claim is delegated to the SAME
    carry-chain template (lucy_dp_delegated_wiring.inner_verify_div) with the
    dividend = e' (point r_u), the quotient = e (point r_e), and acceptance
    restricted to final remainder == p-1.  Returns ok.

    structured (S496 drop-in): when True the delegated inner_verify_div runs
    its backward chain sweep in O(nb*p) prover work (chain_layer_reduce_
    structured) instead of the dense O(nb*p^2) product-of-5-tables sweep, with
    a BIT-IDENTICAL transcript -- accept/reject and comm are unchanged.  Only
    affects the delegated path; the comparator fold above is already O(2^nb)."""
    Dml = 1 << nb
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    eqrv = eq_table(r_v)
    eqru = eq_table(r_u)
    arange = np.arange(Dml, dtype=np.int64)
    img = (arange + 1) * p - 1                  # image of each e under the map
    vmask = img < Dml
    Phi = np.zeros(Dml, dtype=np.uint64)        # Phi[e] = eq(r_u, (e+1)p-1)
    Phi[arange[vmask]] = eqru[img[vmask]]
    Cind = (arange <= ecut).astype(np.uint64)   # [e <= ecut]
    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0

    # inner sum-check (deg 3): waffv = sum_e EQrv(e) Cind(e) Phi(e)
    okI, r_e, finalI, scalI = sumcheck(waffv,
                                       {"EQ": eqrv.copy(), "C": Cind.copy(),
                                        "PHI": Phi.copy()},
                                       [(1, ["EQ", "C", "PHI"])], 3, rng)
    stats["comm"] += 4 * nb
    if not okI:
        return False
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    phi_claim = scalI["PHI"]
    ok = (finalI % Q) == (eq_point(r_v, r_e) * le_eval(r_e, ecut, nb) % Q
                          * phi_claim) % Q
    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    if not ok:
        return False
    # delegate phi_claim = D~(r_e over quotient e, r_u over dividend e'),
    # D(e',e)=[e=floor(e'/p) and e' mod p = p-1]  <=>  e'=p*e+(p-1).
    return inner_verify_div(phi_claim, r_u, r_e, p, nb, rng, stats,
                            accept_rem=p - 1, lie=lie_chain,
                            structured=structured)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# region verifiers (large side)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

def verify_affine_region(S_large, r_v, claimed, p, ecut, nb, rng, stats,
                         cheat=None, delegate=False, structured=False):
    """g1_aff = sum_{e<=ecut} eq(r_v,e) S_large((e+1)p-1).  Routed by image
    index e': g1_aff = sum_{e'} Waff[e'] S_large(e').  The wiring scalar
    Waff~(r_u) = waff_eval(r_v, r_u) is either evaluated by the O(nb*p)
    automaton (delegate=False) or PROVEN by the O(nb*log p) inner protocol
    verify_waff_value (delegate=True).  cheat in
    {None,'waff','waff_forge','waff_chain'}.  structured passes the S496
    O(nb*p) chain prover down to verify_waff_value (delegate path only).
    Returns (ok, r_u, s2)."""
    Dml = 1 << nb
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    eqrv = eq_table(r_v)
    Waff = np.zeros(Dml, dtype=np.uint64)
    for e in range(ecut + 1):
        ep1 = (e + 1) * p - 1
        if ep1 < Dml:
            Waff[ep1] = (int(Waff[ep1]) + int(eqrv[e])) % Q
    if cheat in ("waff", "waff_forge"):                     # wrong affine image
        bad = (p) % Dml
        Waff[bad] = (int(Waff[bad]) + 1) % Q
    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    okB, r_u, finalB, scal = sumcheck(claimed,
                                      {"W": Waff.copy(), "S": S_large.copy()},
                                      [(1, ["W", "S"])], 2, rng)
    stats["comm"] += 3 * nb
    if not okB:
        return False, None, None
    s2 = scal["S"]
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    ok_open = s2 == mle_eval(S_large, r_u)
    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    if not ok_open:
        return False, None, None

    if not delegate:
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        waffv = waff_eval(r_v, r_u, p, ecut, nb)            # O(nb*p) automaton
        ok = (finalB % Q) == waffv * s2 % Q
        stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
        return (ok, r_u, s2) if ok else (False, None, None)

    # delegate: prover supplies waffv (computed Õ(sqrt x), NO automaton), the
    # verifier binds it to finalB and PROVES it via verify_waff_value.
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    if cheat == "waff_forge" and int(s2) % Q != 0:
        waffv = finalB % Q * pow(int(s2) % Q, Q - 2, Q) % Q  # forge to pass algebra
    else:
        eqru = eq_table(r_u)
        e_idx = np.arange(ecut + 1, dtype=np.int64)
        img = (e_idx + 1) * p - 1
        m = img < Dml
        waffv = int((eqrv[e_idx[m]].astype(np.uint64)
                     * eqru[img[m]] % Q).sum(dtype=np.uint64) % Q)
    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    ok = (finalB % Q) == waffv * s2 % Q
    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    if not ok:
        return False, None, None
    okw = verify_waff_value(waffv, r_v, r_u, p, ecut, nb, rng, stats,
                            lie_chain=(cheat == "waff_chain"),
                            structured=structured)
    return (True, r_u, s2) if okw else (False, None, None)


def verify_trace_region(W, S_small, r_v, claimed, lo, hi, nb, rng, stats):
    """g1_trace = sum_{lo<=e<=hi} eq(r_v,e) S_small(floor(x/((e+1)p))).
    Certify every u_e by the step-1 trace zero-test, then route the masked
    small-side lookup. The band mask T(e)=[lo<=e<=hi] zeroes the affine /
    padding columns (whose u_e exceed V) out of the routing.  The lookup is
    over nb-bit values (<= V), taking the LOW nb bits of the certified u_e,
    so omega / S_small stay sqrt x.  Returns (ok, r_B, s_B)."""
    if not verify_constraints(W, rng, stats):
        return False, None, None
    D, Lv = W["D"], W["Lv"]
    e = np.arange(D, dtype=np.int64)
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    Tband = ((e >= lo) & (e <= hi)).astype(np.uint64)
    eqr = eq_table(r_v)
    weight = (eqr * Tband) % Q
    mask = (1 << nb) - 1
    vlow = (W["u"] & mask).astype(np.int64)                 # low nb bits of u_e
    omega = np.zeros(1 << nb, dtype=np.uint64)
    np.add.at(omega, vlow, weight)                          # < D summands < Q
    omega %= Q
    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0

    # B1 (deg 2, v-cube): claimed = sum_v S_small(v) omega(v)
    okB1, r_B, finalB1, sB1 = sumcheck(claimed,
                                       {"S": S_small.copy(), "W": omega.copy()},
                                       [(1, ["S", "W"])], 2, rng)
    stats["comm"] += 3 * nb
    if not okB1:
        return False, None, None
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    okf = ((finalB1 % Q) == sB1["S"] * sB1["W"] % Q
           and sB1["S"] == mle_eval(S_small, r_B))          # opening of S_small
    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    if not okf:
        return False, None, None

    # B2 (deg nb+2, e-cube): sB1[W] = sum_e eq(r_v,e) T(e) prod_k EB_k(e),
    #   EB_k = eq(r_B[k], Ub_{Lv-nb+k})  (the LOW nb bits of the SAME u_e).
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    tabs = {"EQ": eq_table(r_v), "T": Tband.copy()}
    ebn, jidx = [], []
    for k in range(nb):
        j = Lv - nb + k
        jidx.append(j)
        rb = int(r_B[k]) % Q
        Ub = W["tabs"][f"Ub{j}"].astype(np.uint64)
        tabs[f"EB{k}"] = (((1 - rb) % Q) + ((2 * rb - 1) % Q) * Ub) % Q
        ebn.append(f"EB{k}")
    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    okB2, r_C, finalB2, _ = sumcheck(sB1["W"], tabs,
                                     [(1, ["EQ", "T"] + ebn)], nb + 2, rng)
    stats["comm"] += (nb + 3) * nb
    if not okB2:
        return False, None, None
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    expect = eq_point(r_v, r_C) * band_eval(r_C, lo, hi, nb) % Q
    for k in range(nb):
        rb = int(r_B[k]) % Q
        ub = mle_eval(W["tabs"][f"Ub{jidx[k]}"], r_C)       # opening of Ub_j
        expect = expect * (((1 - rb) % Q) + ((2 * rb - 1) % Q) * ub) % Q
    ok = (finalB2 % Q) == expect
    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    return ok, r_B, sB1["S"]


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# claim aggregation: fold same-table point-claims by line restriction
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

def line_batch_pair(S, pt0, val0, pt1, val1, nb, rng, stats):
    """Reduce val0=S~(pt0), val1=S~(pt1) to ONE claim (new_pt, new_claim) via
    the degree-nb line restriction h(t)=S~((1-t)pt0+t pt1). Endpoint checks
    anchor a false input; new_claim is closed by mle_eval (the PCS stand-in)."""
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    hs = []
    for t in range(nb + 1):
        tf = t % Q
        gp = [((Q + 1 - tf) * int(a) + tf * int(b)) % Q
              for a, b in zip(pt0, pt1)]
        hs.append(mle_eval(S, gp))
    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    ok = hs[0] == val0 and hs[1] == val1
    tstar = int(rng.integers(0, Q))
    new_claim = lagrange_eval(hs, tstar)
    new_pt = [((Q + 1 - tstar) * int(a) + tstar * int(b)) % Q
              for a, b in zip(pt0, pt1)]
    ok = ok and new_claim == mle_eval(S, new_pt)            # leaf close
    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    stats["comm"] += nb + 1
    return new_pt, new_claim, ok


def batch_on_table(S, claims, nb, rng, stats):
    """Fold k same-table point-claims into one by sequential line restriction.
    claims: list of (point, value). Returns (point, value, ok)."""
    pt, val = claims[0]
    if len(claims) == 1:                                    # still anchor it
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        ok = val == mle_eval(S, pt)
        stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
        return pt, val, ok
    ok = True
    for (pt1, val1) in claims[1:]:
        pt, val, okp = line_batch_pair(S, pt, val, pt1, val1, nb, rng, stats)
        ok = ok and okp
    return pt, val, ok


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# one compressed layer, each side
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

def pad(tab, nb):
    out = np.zeros(1 << nb, dtype=np.uint64)
    a = (np.asarray(tab, dtype=np.int64) % Q).astype(np.uint64)
    out[:len(a)] = a
    return out


def large_reduce(x, p, sp, ecut, nb, S_prev_small, S_prev_large, z, C,
                 rng, stats, cheat=None, delegate=False, structured=False):
    """Reduce S~_i^large(z)=C to: a large point-claim (new_z,new_claim) on
    S_{i-1}^large (line-batched s1@r_v + s2_aff@r_u) and a small point-claim
    (r_B,s_B) on S_{i-1}^small (trace region). cheat in
    {None,'G','split','u','waff','waff_forge','waff_chain'};
    'wrong_C'/'delta_pi' handled by callers via C.  delegate routes the affine
    wiring scalar through the O(nb log p) inner protocol; structured makes that
    inner protocol's chain prover O(nb*p) (S496 drop-in, delegate path only)."""
    V = isqrt(x)
    ci = sp % Q
    lo, hi = ecut + 1, V - 1
    Bcut = min(V - 1, x // (p * p) - 1)
    Dml = 1 << nb

    # prover-committed G table over the e-cube
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    G = np.zeros(Dml, dtype=np.uint64)
    for e in range(V):
        ep = (e + 1) * p
        G[e] = S_prev_large[ep - 1] if ep <= V else S_prev_small[x // ep]
    if cheat == "G":
        G[0] = (int(G[0]) + 1) % Q
    Bf = (np.arange(Dml) <= Bcut).astype(np.uint64)
    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0

    # ---- phase A ----
    termsA = [(1, ["EQ", "S"]), (Q - 1, ["EQ", "B", "G"]), (ci, ["EQ", "B"])]
    okA, r_v, finalA, scal = sumcheck(C, {"EQ": eq_table(z),
                                          "S": S_prev_large.copy(),
                                          "B": Bf.copy(), "G": G.copy()},
                                      termsA, 3, rng)
    stats["comm"] += 4 * nb
    if not okA:
        return dict(accepted=False)
    s1, g1 = scal["S"], scal["G"]
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    bv = le_eval(r_v, Bcut, nb)
    expect = eq_point(z, r_v) * ((s1 - bv * ((g1 - ci) % Q)) % Q) % Q
    okA2 = (finalA % Q) == expect
    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    if not okA2:
        return dict(accepted=False)

    # ---- honest split of g1 ----
    eqrv_full = eq_table(r_v)
    g1_aff = 0
    for e in range(ecut + 1):
        g1_aff = (g1_aff + int(eqrv_full[e]) * int(S_prev_large[(e + 1) * p - 1])) % Q
    g1_trace = 0
    for e in range(lo, hi + 1):
        g1_trace = (g1_trace + int(eqrv_full[e]) * int(S_prev_small[x // ((e + 1) * p)])) % Q
    if cheat == "split":
        g1_aff = (g1_aff + 1) % Q
        g1_trace = (g1_trace - 1) % Q
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    ok_sum = (g1_aff + g1_trace) % Q == g1 % Q
    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    if not ok_sum:
        return dict(accepted=False)

    # ---- affine region ----
    okAff, r_u, s2_aff = verify_affine_region(
        S_prev_large, r_v, g1_aff, p, ecut, nb, rng, stats,
        cheat=(cheat if cheat in ("waff", "waff_forge", "waff_chain")
               else None),
        delegate=delegate, structured=structured)
    if not okAff:
        return dict(accepted=False)

    # ---- trace region ----
    W = build_witness(x, p, nb, dstart=1)
    if cheat == "u":                                        # wrong quotient in trace
        d = max(lo, 1) % W["D"]
        W["tabs"]["U"] = W["tabs"]["U"].copy()
        W["tabs"]["U"][d] = (int(W["tabs"]["U"][d]) + 1) % Q
    okTr, r_B, s_B = verify_trace_region(
        W, S_prev_small, r_v, g1_trace, lo, hi, nb, rng, stats)
    if not okTr:
        return dict(accepted=False)

    # ---- line-batch s1@r_v and s2_aff@r_u (both on S_prev_large) ----
    new_z, new_claim, okL = line_batch_pair(
        S_prev_large, r_v, s1, r_u, s2_aff, nb, rng, stats)
    if not okL:
        return dict(accepted=False)

    return dict(accepted=True, s_B=s_B, r_B=r_B,
                new_claim=new_claim, new_z=new_z, r_v=r_v)


def small_reduce(x, p, sp, nb, S_prev_small, z, C, rng, stats, cheat=None,
                 delegate=False, structured=False):
    """Reduce S~_i^small(z)=C to TWO point-claims on S_{i-1}^small:
    (r_v,s1) [the v itself] and (r_u,s2) [floor(v/p)]. The wiring v->floor(v/p)
    stays entirely small-side (value->value): the existing division automaton.
    Gate B(v)=[p^2<=v<=V] is a BAND (the upper bound keeps the recurrence off
    the padding). cheat in {None,'small_G','small_u','small_forge',
    'small_chain'}; 'small_C' via C.  delegate routes the division wiring
    scalar W~(r_v,r_u) through the SAME carry-chain (inner_verify_div);
    structured makes that chain prover O(nb*p) (S496 drop-in, delegate only)."""
    V = isqrt(x)
    ci = sp % Q
    p2 = p * p
    Dml = 1 << nb
    arange = np.arange(Dml, dtype=np.int64)

    # ---- phase A: C = sum_v eq(z,v)[S(v) - B(v)(G(v)-ci)] ----
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    Bf = ((arange >= p2) & (arange <= V)).astype(np.uint64)     # band [p^2<=v<=V]
    Gf = S_prev_small[arange // p].astype(np.uint64).copy()     # G(v)=S(floor(v/p))
    if cheat == "small_G":
        gi = (p2) % Dml
        Gf[gi] = (int(Gf[gi]) + 1) % Q
    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    termsA = [(1, ["EQ", "S"]), (Q - 1, ["EQ", "B", "G"]), (ci, ["EQ", "B"])]
    okA, r_v, finalA, scal = sumcheck(C, {"EQ": eq_table(z),
                                          "S": S_prev_small.copy(),
                                          "B": Bf.copy(), "G": Gf.copy()},
                                      termsA, 3, rng)
    stats["comm"] += 4 * nb
    if not okA:
        return dict(accepted=False)
    s1, g1 = scal["S"], scal["G"]
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    bv = band_eval(r_v, p2, V, nb)
    expect = eq_point(z, r_v) * ((s1 - bv * ((g1 - ci) % Q)) % Q) % Q
    okA2 = (finalA % Q) == expect
    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    if not okA2:
        return dict(accepted=False)

    # ---- phase B: g1 = sum_u W(r_v,u) S(u),  W(v,u)=[u=floor(v/p)] ----
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    eqrv = eq_table(r_v)
    Wt = np.zeros(Dml, dtype=np.uint64)
    np.add.at(Wt, arange // p, eqrv)                        # < p summands < Q
    Wt %= Q
    if cheat in ("small_u", "small_forge"):
        Wt[0] = (int(Wt[0]) + 1) % Q
    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    okB, r_u, finalB, scalB = sumcheck(g1, {"W": Wt, "S": S_prev_small.copy()},
                                       [(1, ["W", "S"])], 2, rng)
    stats["comm"] += 3 * nb
    if not okB:
        return dict(accepted=False)
    s2 = scalB["S"]

    if not delegate:
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        wv = w_div_eval(r_v, r_u, p, nb)                    # O(nb*p) automaton
        okB2 = (finalB % Q) == wv * s2 % Q
        stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
        if not okB2:
            return dict(accepted=False)
        return dict(accepted=True, claims=[(r_v, s1), (r_u, s2)])

    # delegate: prover supplies the wiring scalar (Õ(sqrt x), NO automaton),
    # verifier binds it to finalB then PROVES it via the carry chain.
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    if cheat == "small_forge" and int(s2) % Q != 0:
        wv_claim = finalB % Q * pow(int(s2) % Q, Q - 2, Q) % Q  # forge to pass algebra
    else:
        eqru = eq_table(r_u)
        wv_claim = int((eqrv.astype(np.uint64)
                        * eqru[arange // p] % Q).sum(dtype=np.uint64) % Q)
    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    okB2 = (finalB % Q) == wv_claim * s2 % Q
    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    if not okB2:
        return dict(accepted=False)
    if not inner_verify_div(wv_claim, r_v, r_u, p, nb, rng, stats,
                            accept_rem=None, lie=(cheat == "small_chain"),
                            structured=structured):
        return dict(accepted=False)
    return dict(accepted=True, claims=[(r_v, s1), (r_u, s2)])


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# single-layer test drivers
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

def _result(accepted, x, p, C, stats, nb, ecut, **extra):
    d = dict(accepted=accepted, x=x, p=p, C=C, nb=nb, ecut=ecut, **stats)
    d.update(extra)
    return d


def run_layer(x, layer, rng, z=None, cheat=None, delegate=False,
              structured=False):
    """Verify ONE large-side compressed layer (step-2 single-layer test).
    cheat in {None, wrong_C, G, split, u, waff, waff_forge, waff_chain}."""
    V = isqrt(x)
    nb = max(1, V.bit_length())
    primes, sm_layers, lg_layers = compressed_lucy(x)
    assert 1 <= layer <= len(primes)
    p = primes[layer - 1]
    sp = sm_layers[layer - 1][p - 1]
    ecut = V // p - 1
    S_prev_small = pad(sm_layers[layer - 1], nb)
    S_prev_large = pad(lg_layers[layer - 1], nb)
    S_i_large = pad(lg_layers[layer], nb)
    if z is None:
        z = [int(rng.integers(0, Q)) for _ in range(nb)]
    C = mle_eval(S_i_large, z)
    if cheat == "wrong_C":
        C = (C + 1) % Q
    stats = {"t_prover": 0.0, "t_verifier": 0.0, "comm": 0}
    res = large_reduce(x, p, sp, ecut, nb, S_prev_small, S_prev_large, z, C,
                       rng, stats,
                       cheat=(cheat if cheat in ("G", "split", "u", "waff",
                                                 "waff_forge", "waff_chain")
                              else None),
                       delegate=delegate, structured=structured)
    out = _result(res["accepted"], x, p, C, stats, nb, ecut)
    if res["accepted"]:
        out.update(s_B=res["s_B"], r_B=res["r_B"], new_claim=res["new_claim"],
                   new_z=res["new_z"], S_prev_small=S_prev_small,
                   S_prev_large=S_prev_large)
    return out


def run_two_sided_layer(x, layer, rng, cheat=None, delegate=False,
                        structured=False):
    """Verify ONE full two-sided layer: (large-claim, small-claim) ->
    (large-claim', small-claim'). Small-side claims about S_{i-1}^small (s_B
    from the large trace + the two from the small layer) are folded to one."""
    V = isqrt(x)
    nb = max(1, V.bit_length())
    primes, sm_layers, lg_layers = compressed_lucy(x)
    assert 1 <= layer <= len(primes)
    p = primes[layer - 1]
    sp = sm_layers[layer - 1][p - 1]
    ecut = V // p - 1
    S_prev_small = pad(sm_layers[layer - 1], nb)
    S_prev_large = pad(lg_layers[layer - 1], nb)
    S_i_large = pad(lg_layers[layer], nb)
    S_i_small = pad(sm_layers[layer], nb)
    stats = {"t_prover": 0.0, "t_verifier": 0.0, "comm": 0}

    zL = [int(rng.integers(0, Q)) for _ in range(nb)]
    zS = [int(rng.integers(0, Q)) for _ in range(nb)]
    CL = mle_eval(S_i_large, zL)
    CS = mle_eval(S_i_small, zS)
    if cheat == "wrong_C":
        CL = (CL + 1) % Q
    if cheat == "small_C":
        CS = (CS + 1) % Q

    lres = large_reduce(x, p, sp, ecut, nb, S_prev_small, S_prev_large, zL, CL,
                        rng, stats,
                        cheat=(cheat if cheat in ("G", "split", "u", "waff",
                                                  "waff_forge", "waff_chain")
                               else None),
                        delegate=delegate, structured=structured)
    if not lres["accepted"]:
        return dict(accepted=False, x=x, p=p, nb=nb, ecut=ecut, **stats)
    sres = small_reduce(x, p, sp, nb, S_prev_small, zS, CS, rng, stats,
                        cheat=(cheat if cheat in ("small_G", "small_u",
                                                  "small_forge", "small_chain")
                               else None),
                        delegate=delegate, structured=structured)
    if not sres["accepted"]:
        return dict(accepted=False, x=x, p=p, nb=nb, ecut=ecut, **stats)

    sB = lres["s_B"]
    if cheat == "carry":                                    # tamper cross-side carry
        sB = (sB + 1) % Q
    small_claims = [(lres["r_B"], sB)] + sres["claims"]
    zS2, CS2, okb = batch_on_table(S_prev_small, small_claims, nb, rng, stats)

    out_ok = (okb
              and CS2 == mle_eval(S_prev_small, zS2)
              and lres["new_claim"] == mle_eval(S_prev_large, lres["new_z"]))
    return dict(accepted=out_ok, x=x, p=p, nb=nb, ecut=ecut,
                CS2=CS2, zS2=zS2, new_claim=lres["new_claim"],
                new_z=lres["new_z"], S_prev_small=S_prev_small,
                S_prev_large=S_prev_large, **stats)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# the full compressed chain: verify pi(x) end-to-end
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

def run_chain(x, rng, cheat=None, corrupt_layer=None, delegate=False,
              structured=False):
    """Chain all K layers from S_K^large(e=0)=pi(x) down to S_0 (opened on
    both sides). cheat='delta_pi' lies about pi(x); corrupt_layer=i0 is a
    self-consistent liar. delegate routes BOTH wirings (small division,
    large affine image) through the O(nb log p) inner protocol -- the whole
    per-layer verifier is then O(nb log p), no p-linear automaton term.
    structured (delegate only) makes the inner chain PROVER O(nb*p) per wiring
    (S496 drop-in) -- whole-chain wiring prover Õ(x^{3/2})->Õ(x), transcript
    bit-identical.  Returns dict(accepted, claimed, layers, ...)."""
    V = isqrt(x)
    nb = max(1, V.bit_length())
    primes, sm_layers, lg_layers = compressed_lucy(x)
    K = len(primes)
    if corrupt_layer is not None:
        sm_layers, lg_layers = corrupt_compressed(primes, sm_layers,
                                                  lg_layers, x, corrupt_layer)
    claimed_pi = lg_layers[K][0]
    if cheat == "delta_pi":
        claimed_pi += 1

    stats = {"t_prover": 0.0, "t_verifier": 0.0, "comm": 0}
    z_large = [0] * nb                                       # Boolean point e=0
    C_large = claimed_pi % Q
    z_small, C_small = None, None

    def fail():
        return dict(accepted=False, claimed=claimed_pi, layers=K, **stats)

    for i in range(K, 0, -1):
        p = primes[i - 1]
        sp = sm_layers[i - 1][p - 1]
        ecut = V // p - 1
        S_prev_small = pad(sm_layers[i - 1], nb)
        S_prev_large = pad(lg_layers[i - 1], nb)

        lres = large_reduce(x, p, sp, ecut, nb, S_prev_small, S_prev_large,
                            z_large, C_large, rng, stats, delegate=delegate,
                            structured=structured)
        if not lres["accepted"]:
            return fail()
        small_claims = [(lres["r_B"], lres["s_B"])]
        if C_small is not None:                             # skipped at i=K
            sres = small_reduce(x, p, sp, nb, S_prev_small, z_small, C_small,
                                rng, stats, delegate=delegate,
                                structured=structured)
            if not sres["accepted"]:
                return fail()
            small_claims += sres["claims"]
        z_small, C_small, okb = batch_on_table(S_prev_small, small_claims,
                                               nb, rng, stats)
        if not okb:
            return fail()
        z_large, C_large = lres["new_z"], lres["new_claim"]

    # base: open S_0 on both sides (leaf-opening stand-in, O(sqrt x) once)
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    S0_large = pad(lg_layers[0], nb)
    S0_small = pad(sm_layers[0], nb)
    ok = (C_large == mle_eval(S0_large, z_large)
          and C_small == mle_eval(S0_small, z_small))
    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    return dict(accepted=ok, claimed=claimed_pi, layers=K, **stats)

def sieve_pi(x):
    s = np.ones(x + 1, dtype=bool)
    s[:2] = False
    for q in range(2, isqrt(x) + 1):
        if s[q]:
            s[q * q::q] = False
    return int(s.sum())


def selftest():
    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
    # 1. compressed DP == sieve
    for n in range(6, 17):
        x = (1 << n) - 1
        _, _, lg = compressed_lucy(x)
        assert lg[-1][0] == sieve_pi(x), n

    # 2. le / band MLEs vs Boolean truth (exhaustive small n)
    for n in (3, 4, 5):
        for M in range(-1, (1 << n) + 1):
            for e in range(1 << n):
                be = [(e >> (n - 1 - j)) & 1 for j in range(n)]
                assert le_eval(be, M, n) == (1 if e <= M else 0), (n, M, e)
        for lo in range(0, 1 << n):
            for hi in range(lo, 1 << n):
                for e in range(1 << n):
                    be = [(e >> (n - 1 - j)) & 1 for j in range(n)]
                    assert band_eval(be, lo, hi, n) == (1 if lo <= e <= hi else 0)
        # empty band (lo>hi, e.g. small-side gate when p^2>V) -> all-zero MLE
        for lo in range(1, 1 << n):
            r = [int(rng.integers(0, Q)) for _ in range(n)]
            assert band_eval(r, lo, lo - 1, n) == 0

    # 3. waff_eval vs Boolean truth and vs full-table MLE at random points
    for (n, p) in [(4, 3), (5, 5), (5, 7), (6, 2)]:
        for ecut in (0, 1, (1 << n) // p):
            full = np.zeros(1 << (2 * n), dtype=np.uint64)
            for e in range(1 << n):
                ep1 = p * e + (p - 1)
                if e <= ecut and ep1 < (1 << n):
                    full[(e << n) | ep1] = 1
            for e in range(1 << n):
                for ep in range(1 << n):
                    be = [(e >> (n - 1 - j)) & 1 for j in range(n)]
                    bp = [(ep >> (n - 1 - j)) & 1 for j in range(n)]
                    want = 1 if (e <= ecut and ep == p * e + (p - 1)) else 0
                    assert waff_eval(be, bp, p, ecut, n) == want, (n, p, ecut, e, ep)
            for _ in range(5):
                rv = [int(rng.integers(0, Q)) for _ in range(n)]
                ru = [int(rng.integers(0, Q)) for _ in range(n)]
                assert waff_eval(rv, ru, p, ecut, n) == mle_eval(full, rv + ru)

    # 4. honest LARGE layer accepts; output claims equal true MLEs of S_{i-1}
    for (n, layer) in [(10, 2), (10, 4), (12, 3), (12, 5)]:
        x = (1 << n) - 1
        res = run_layer(x, layer, np.random.default_rng(7))
        assert res["accepted"], (n, layer)
        assert res["s_B"] == mle_eval(res["S_prev_small"], res["r_B"])
        assert res["new_claim"] == mle_eval(res["S_prev_large"], res["new_z"])

    # 5. honest g1 == g1_aff + g1_trace decomposition (phase-A / phase-B tie)
    x = (1 << 12) - 1
    V = isqrt(x); nb = V.bit_length()
    primes, sm, lg = compressed_lucy(x)
    p = primes[3]; ecut = V // p - 1; lo, hi = ecut + 1, V - 1
    S_prev_small = pad(sm[3], nb); S_prev_large = pad(lg[3], nb)
    r_v = [int(rng.integers(0, Q)) for _ in range(nb)]
    eqrv = eq_table(r_v)
    G = np.zeros(1 << nb, dtype=np.uint64)
    for e in range(V):
        ep = (e + 1) * p
        G[e] = S_prev_large[ep - 1] if ep <= V else S_prev_small[x // ep]
    g1 = mle_eval(G, r_v)
    g1a = sum(int(eqrv[e]) * int(S_prev_large[(e + 1) * p - 1])
              for e in range(ecut + 1)) % Q
    g1t = sum(int(eqrv[e]) * int(S_prev_small[x // ((e + 1) * p)])
              for e in range(lo, hi + 1)) % Q
    assert (g1a + g1t) % Q == g1 % Q

    # 6. LARGE-side soundness: every cheat class rejected across primes/layers
    for (n, layer) in [(10, 3), (12, 4), (12, 6)]:
        x = (1 << n) - 1
        for ch in ["wrong_C", "G", "split", "u", "waff"]:
            rej = sum(not run_layer(x, layer, np.random.default_rng(50 + t),
                                    cheat=ch)["accepted"] for t in range(8))
            assert rej == 8, (n, layer, ch, rej)

    # 7. honest SMALL layer accepts; both output claims equal true MLEs.
    #    (also exercises padding via odd n: V != 2^nb-1)
    for (n, layer) in [(10, 2), (11, 3), (12, 4), (12, 6), (13, 5)]:
        x = (1 << n) - 1
        Vv = isqrt(x); nbv = max(1, Vv.bit_length())
        primes, sm, lg = compressed_lucy(x)
        p = primes[layer - 1]
